proposed_oracle_resolution.empty_sample_point: At actual condition_variable::wait_for return after InputQueueMutex reacquired, if StopGateway is false and InputQueue is empty; increment one saturating observation and event sequence there.
proposed_oracle_resolution.q1_correlation: WaitCapture and DecisionCapture are sticky; capture returned wait predicate value and the existing strict due/pop branch only; same iteration ID, increasing sequence and identical target/head/candidate scalar ID are required; overflow/mismatch is INCONCLUSIVE.
proposed_oracle_resolution.run_cardinality: Single process with Q0->Q1 phases under ordered gate. All cardinality invariants = 1: process_start_count, run_id_count, journal_count, final_record_count.
proposed_oracle_resolution.synchronization: One lock at existing admission/wait/pop sites; no recursive lock; scalar-copy accessor under InputQueueMutex; no observer Message*; counters saturate and overflow fails closed.
